Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Sword & Crown <sword@mcs.com> wrote:
>-Have you been frustrated by the rising costs of Magic cards?

I assume you mean rising costs of cards sold over the net, as opposed
to the prices of starters and boosters, whose recommended retail
price hasn't been raised one cent.  You should really be clear about
this sort of thing...  WotC gets enough badmouthing from those unclear
on the reality as it is.  Thanks.


Tom Wylie		rec.games.deckmaster Network Representative for
aahz@hal.com			Wizards of the Coast, Inc.
